title: Upper quantile near unit tail probability
statement: Let $Z$ be a standard normal random variable, and for $0<\alpha<1$ let $Q(\alpha)$ be the unique real number whose standard Gaussian upper-tail probability is $\alpha$. Extend $Q$ to all real $\alpha$ by setting it to $0$ outside $(0,1)$. As $\alpha$ tends to $1$ from below, $Q(\alpha)$ tends to $-\infty$.
